integrity: The argument is self-contained after the displayed map assumptions; the exact-rational checker illustrates branch and fixed-point identities but cannot establish claims for continuum parameter ranges. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The sharp bound is relative to the largest left excursion of a compact invariant set; it does not establish persistence or global size bounds for chaotic attractors. The equal-eigenvalue collapse was already proved in earlier work.
title: Sharp one-sided compact-recurrence confinement near a shared stable eigenvalue
